ACT 01 — OUR ORIGIN SCRIPT

Forged in Bengaluru.
Proven across the globe.

Founded in 2019 by Dhanu Krishnnaa, Digital Magnet Media was built on a singular conviction: modern digital marketing should look, feel, and resonate like cinema—backed by serious performance engineering.

THE FOUNDER’S VISION
“We build campaigns that cut through the noise—pairing clear brand conviction with measurable commercial performance.”

In 2019, digital marketing was drowning in automated jargon, sterile analytics dashboards, and interchangeable creative templates. Brands were spending millions yet remaining emotionally invisible. Dhanu Krishnnaa founded Digital Magnet Media in Bengaluru to pursue a hybrid discipline: cinematic, narrative-driven brand building integrated with technical performance marketing.

Since 2019, Dhanu has spearheaded high-velocity go-to-market roadmaps, hyper-growth scaling initiatives, and cultural brand turns. Today, operating across our office branches in Bengaluru and New York, our office branch stewards brands with the same conviction: challenger spirit and precise execution.
